summary.text: Marci Mustello is the Republican incumbent, in office since June 4, 2019, seeking re-election to the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 11, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Marci Mustello assumed office on June 4, 2019.
Ballotpedia lists her 2023-2024 committee assignments as Agriculture & Rural Affairs, Appropriations (where she was subcommittee chair on Education), and Gaming Oversight.
